title: Distinct prelimbic microcircuits control sensory and affective dimensions of neuropathic pain
title_zh: 前缘叶不同微环路分别控制神经病理性疼痛的感觉和情感维度
abstract: The microcircuit mechanisms underlying deactivation and altered output of the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC), a common feature of several chronic pain conditions, are poorly understood. Here, using unbiased in vivo longitudinal multiphoton imaging in the mouse prelimbic cortex (PrL), we show that nerve injury induces sensitization of all classes of GABAergic interneurons and a phenotypic switch from unimodal to polymodal responses. Through circuit interrogation, we identified functions for caudal geminal eminence-derived Prox1+ interneurons and revealed that distinct classes of inhibitory and excitatory neurons in the PrL have different functions in promoting neuropathic pain. In addition, we show that the sensory and affective dimensions of neuropathic pain engaged two distinct microcircuits, PV+-Rbp4+ neurons and Prox1+-Cux2+/Ntsr1+ neurons, respectively, to control distinct projection outputs. These findings provide a mechanistic basis for how mPFC guides actions to avoid or overcome pain and how prefrontal deactivation exacerbates neuropathic pain. Gan et al. report the cellular mechanisms underlying dysbalance of prefrontal brain activity in mice with neuropathic pain and delineate the circuitry through which the prefrontal cortex exerts top-down control of sensory and emotional aspects of pain.
abstract_zh: 内侧前额叶皮层（mPFC）去激活和输出改变的微环路机制尚不明确，而这是几种慢性疼痛疾病的常见特征。本文利用小鼠前缘叶皮层（PrL）中无偏体内纵向双光子成像，揭示神经损伤导致所有类型GABA能中间神经元敏感化，并出现由单模态到多模态响应的表型转变。通过电路干预，我们确定了尾侧牙质区来源Prox1+中间神经元的功能，并表明PrL中不同类别的抑制性和兴奋性神经元在促进神经病理性疼痛中具有不同的功能。此外，神经病理性疼痛的感觉和情感维度分别依赖PV+-Rbp4+神经元和Prox1+-Cux2+/Ntsr1+神经元两个不同微环路来控制不同的投射输出。这些发现为mPFC如何引导行为以避免或克服疼痛，以及前额叶去激活如何加重神经病理性疼痛提供了机制依据。Gan等人揭示了神经病理性疼痛小鼠中前额叶脑活动失衡的细胞机制，并界定了前额叶对疼痛感觉和情感成分进行自上而下控制的电路。
